mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_case_task (id, workspace_id, case_id, task_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{caseId}, #{taskId}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT ct.case_id, ct.task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.item_type, t.board_column, t.demand_id, t.item_no FROM test_case_task ct JOIN task t ON t.id = ct.task_id AND t.workspace_id = ct.workspace_id WHERE ct.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ct.case_id IN #{id} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.item_no IS NULL, t.item_no, t.created_at, t.id

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title AS task_title, t.item_no, t.item_type, t.board_column, COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested FROM task t LEFT JOIN test_case_task ct ON ct.task_id = t.id AND ct.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN test_case c ON c.id = ct.case_id AND c.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.demand_id = #{demandId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.item_no, t.item_type, t.board_column, t.created_at ORDER BY t.item_no IS NULL, t.item_no, t.created_at, t.id

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.demand_id, t.title AS task_title, t.item_no, t.item_type, t.board_column, COUNT(c.id) AS case_total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'passed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.latest_status = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL AND c.latest_status IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS untested FROM task t LEFT JOIN test_case_task ct ON ct.task_id = t.id AND ct.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN test_case c ON c.id = ct.case_id AND c.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.id, t.demand_id, t.title, t.item_no, t.item_type, t.board_column, t.created_at ORDER BY t.item_no IS NULL, t.item_no, t.created_at, t.id
SELECT task_id FROM test_case_task WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
